FileItemDao.getByParent runs named query getFilesByParent ('SELECT f FROM FileItem f WHERE f.deleted = false AND f.parentId = :parentId ...') with no authorization predicates. Source-to-sink: authenticated ROOM user -> attacker-controlled parentId -> unfiltered getByParent -> FileItemDTO list.
